figs.name: strainer-and-filter-pipeline-location-diagram
figs.alt: strainer before a pump and filter with DP gauge before hydraulic equipment in a pipeline
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing a strainer protecting the pump from large debris and a fine filter with a DP gauge cleaning the fluid before precision equipment.

<line x1="245" y1="170" x2="245" y2="230" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="215" y="142" font-size="18" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Strainer</text>
<line x1="260" y1="200" x2="320" y2="200" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="5"/>

<text x="590.0" y="456.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">element often replaced</text>
</svg>

figs.name: strainer-and-filter-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: strainer and filter selection flowchart by equipment protection or fluid cleanliness goal
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the field rule: use a strainer for equipment protection, a filter when fine particles matter, and the two common selection mistakes.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 540" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Strainer or filter selection flowchart with common selection mistakes</title>
<rect width="800" height="540" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Strainer or Filter? A Simple Selection Flow</text>
<polygon points="400,65.0 590.0,120 400,175.0 210.0,120" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="115.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Goal is to protect equipment</text>
<text x="400" y="136.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">from large debris?</text>
<polyline points="210,120 105,120 105,145" fill="none" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="160" y="108" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="20" y="150" width="170" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="105.0" y="177.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Use a strainer</text>
<text x="105.0" y="200.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">low pressure drop</text>
<line x1="400" y1="177" x2="400" y2="200" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="195" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<polygon points="400,203.0 590.0,258 400,313.0 210.0,258" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="253.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Fine particles cause wear,</text>
<text x="400" y="274.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">blockage or errors?</text>
<polyline points="590,258 680,258 680,320" fill="none" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="640" y="246" font-size="17" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="590" y="325" width="180" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="680.0" y="354.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Use a filter</text>
<text x="680.0" y="377.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">add a DP alarm</text>
<line x1="400" y1="315" x2="400" y2="338" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="333" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="260" y="342" width="280" height="56" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="375.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">A strainer is enough</text>
<rect x="30" y="420" width="360" height="100" rx="10" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210.0" y="452.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Mistake 1</text>
<text x="210.0" y="475.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">strainer where a filter is needed:</text>
<text x="210.0" y="498.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">wear, valve sticking</text>
<rect x="410" y="420" width="360" height="100" rx="10" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="590.0" y="452.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Mistake 2</text>
<text x="590.0" y="475.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">fine filter where a strainer is</text>
<text x="590.0" y="498.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">enough: pressure loss, cost</text>
</svg>
